name: Fashion & Apparel Design
description: AI-assisted fashion and apparel design platform. Supports structured blueprint building, panel validation, trademark safety, colorway management, and composition output generation for t-shirt, jersey, hoodie, uniform, jacket, dress, batik-inspired apparel, and merchandise.

routesToMount.instruction: Add: import fashionDesignRouter from './fashion-design'; then router.use(fashionDesignRouter); at the end of the file.

publicRouteException.comment: Fashion design service catalog — public metadata endpoint (no customer data exposed).

pagesToRegister.instruction: Add import and <Route path='/fashion-design' component={FashionDesign} /> inside AdminRouter.
Add lazy import and <Route path='/fashion-design' component={FashionDesignPage} /> inside Router.

schemaExportsRequested.instruction: Copy domain schema from artifacts/api-server/src/domains/fashion-design/schema.ts to lib/db/src/schema/fashion-design.ts, then add export to barrel. Requires drizzle-zod for createInsertSchema if needed.

database.migrationStatus: draft — do NOT apply; Team 24 to apply via controlled migration process

tables.name: fashion_design_orders
tables.description: Apparel design orders from submission to delivery

tables.name: fashion_design_blueprints
tables.description: Panel-by-panel blueprint specifications, one per order (UNIQUE order_id, CASCADE delete)

safetyRules: No final production garment patterns without size specification and technical review
No copying or referencing well-known brand jerseys or motifs (trademark blocklist enforced)
Panel constraints validated on blueprint save (min/max width/height per panel)
Jersey numbering validated: must be numeric, 0–99
Logo placement validated against panel bounds
Motif repeat scale must be between 0 and 10
Trademark-flagged orders cannot be approved or delivered
integrationNotes: Domain schema is at artifacts/api-server/src/domains/fashion-design/schema.ts — self-contained, does NOT use @workspace/db barrel for table definitions.
fashionDesignRouter must be registered in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/index.ts by Team 24.
GET /api/ai/fashion-design/services must be added to PUBLIC_ROUTE_RULES in adminAuth.ts by Team 24.
Frontend routes must be added to both App.tsx files by Team 24.
DB tables must be created by running integration/migrations/team-18.sql against Supabase — controlled by Team 24.
Image generation outputs (flat-design, front-back-preview) require integration with AI pipeline — currently return null with status note.
Batik motif generation should respect traditional Javanese/Indonesian pattern integrity.
remediationNotes: Locked file violations fixed: reverted routes/index.ts, adminAuth.ts, lib/db/src/schema/index.ts, both App.tsx files. Schema moved to domain-local. adminAuth added explicitly to all admin routes.
